annotations.title: imagepeek: compress an image (optionally to a byte budget)

description: imagepeek: Compress an image, optionally to a byte budget. To change the format only use image_convert. Returns a smaller JPEG, WebP, AVIF or PNG (or original if not smaller). With `max_bytes`, default `fit: quality` keeps dimensions; `fit: downscale` tries up to 6 aspect-preserving reductions, quality >=10, `min_side`=256, never upscales, one time budget. Check `target_met`. Reads PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, TIFF, BMP, ICO and AVIF; other formats and images over 40 megapixels are refused (not charged). Output: base64 `data_base64`, without EXIF, GPS, XMP or IPTC; over 15 MB or 50 megapixels is a 413 (not charged). Images are not logged; a result is kept only with `output` "url" (24 h). Typically 0.5-2 s. Price: USD 0.003. Free: 3 imagepeek calls per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/image-compress-api.html

auto_orient.description: Apply the EXIF orientation first (default true).
auto_orient.title: Auto Orient

colors.description: png: quantise to this many colours.
colors.title: Colors

fit.description: Requires max_bytes when supplied. quality (default) keeps dimensions; downscale tries up to 6 smaller sizes with the same aspect ratio, searching quality >= 10 at each size under one time budget. Check target_met; fitting is not guaranteed. Downscale requires quality >= 10 if set.
fit.title: Fit

format.description: Output format: jpeg, png, webp or avif (default: the input's).
format.title: Format

image_base64.description: The image as standard or url-safe base64 (at most 10 MB decoded; a data:image/...;base64, prefix is fine); or use url.
image_base64.title: Image Base64

keep_icc.description: Keep the ICC colour profile (default true).
keep_icc.title: Keep Icc

max_bytes.description: Size target: the highest quality that fits.
max_bytes.title: Max Bytes

min_side.description: downscale only: shortest-side floor in pixels (1-32768, default 256). Inputs already below this floor are not resized; never upscales.
min_side.title: Min Side

output.description: base64 (default): the file comes back inline as base64. url: the file is stored for 24 hours and the reply carries a download link (url, expires_at, bytes, content_type, sha256) instead of the base64, which keeps the file out of your context window.
output.title: Output

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the image (at most 10 MB; private, internal and IP-literal hosts are refused); or use image_base64.
url.title: Url

name: image_compress

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.

scale_factor.description: downscale only: uniform scale relative to the EXIF-oriented input, before rounding dimensions; 1 for an unchanged original.
